longsword.name: Longsword
longsword.description: Good steel, badly maintained, still sharp where it counts.

shortbow.name: Shortbow
shortbow.description: Horn and sinew. The draw is light and the string is older than you are.

dagger.name: Dagger
dagger.description: Everyone in the Warrens owns one. Almost nobody uses it for fighting.

mace.name: Mace
mace.description: A weight on a stick. Honest about what it is for.

iron_spade.name: Iron Spade
iron_spade.description: Worn to a bevel at one corner from a decade of frozen ground.

warhammer.name: Warhammer
warhammer.description: A weight on a haft. It does not need to be sharp and it knows it.

spear.name: Spear
spear.description: Ash shaft, leaf head. The oldest answer to the oldest problem.

bound_tome.name: Bound Tome
bound_tome.description: Somebody wrote all of this down. You went and read it.

chain_censer.name: Chain Censer
chain_censer.description: Smoke on a chain, swung to keep something at a distance. Nobody has fully explained what.

shield.name: Shield
shield.description: Banded oak. The boss is dented inward in the shape of something's tooth.

focus_rod.name: Focus Rod
focus_rod.description: Blackened at one end. It is always slightly warmer than the room.

warding_lantern.name: Warding Lantern
warding_lantern.description: The flame inside leans toward whatever is about to happen, and it leans hard.

sporecap_charm.name: Sporecap Charm
sporecap_charm.description: A dried cap on a wire loop. It twitches when something wet moves nearby.

tidewarden_seal.name: Tidewarden's Seal
tidewarden_seal.description: Maugrim's collar-plate, still warm. The gate-wardens of Ashvault will know it on sight.

drowned_crown.name: Drowned Crown
drowned_crown.description: Coral has grown through the band and set it to a head that is no longer there.

warden_robe.name: Warden's Robe
warden_robe.description: Sodden and heavy, and yet it dries the moment you stop looking at it.

tidecleaver.name: Tidecleaver
tidecleaver.description: The edge is wet. It has been out of the water for an hour and the edge is wet.

ration.name: Ration
ration.description: Hard bread, harder cheese. Only any use when nothing is trying to kill you.

health_draught.name: Health Draught
health_draught.description: Tastes of iron filings and regret. Works, though.

sporecap_elixir.name: Sporecap Elixir
sporecap_elixir.description: Thick, green, and faintly warm in the throat going down.

spellbook.name: Spellbook
spellbook.description: Your own handwriting, getting worse toward the back.

rope.name: Rope (30ft)
rope.description: Hemp, waxed. Thirty feet is never quite enough and always too heavy.

holy_sigil.name: Holy Sigil
holy_sigil.description: A lantern struck in tin. Cheap. Everyone here has one.

signal_horn.name: Signal Horn
signal_horn.description: One long note carries two miles. Down here it carries rather less.

waterlogged_journal.name: Waterlogged Journal
waterlogged_journal.description: Half the pages have fused. The half that survived is the half you needed.

bent_lockpicks.name: Bent Lockpicks
bent_lockpicks.description: Four picks and a tension wrench, all of them reshaped at least once.

coil_of_line.name: Coil of Line
coil_of_line.description: Tarred river line. It has held heavier than you and it did not ask what for.

iron_ledger.name: Iron Ledger
iron_ledger.description: Bound in banded iron so it survives the kind of conversation it tends to start.

pit_lamp.name: Pit Lamp
pit_lamp.description: Gauze-shielded, so it will not set light to what it finds. It has been lit almost continuously since you were six.

broken_sigil.name: Broken Sigil
broken_sigil.description: You put it down on the flagstones yourself. Picking it back up afterwards was not part of the plan.

bundle_of_reeds.name: Bundle of Reeds
bundle_of_reeds.description: Cut on the right night, dried the right way. It is not respectable and it has never once failed you.

cut_colours.name: Cut Colours
cut_colours.description: A strip of a standard, cut away rather than dropped. You have never been able to explain the difference and have stopped trying.

gravebell.name: Grave-Bell
gravebell.description: Small, cold, and it never quite stops ringing. You have stopped mentioning that to people.

wardens_key.name: The Warden's Key
wardens_key.description: It opens nothing in the Hollow Crypt. Everyone who has carried one out says the same thing: it gets warmer the closer you get to Ashvault.

warden_crown.name: Crown of Keeping
warden_crown.description: Iron, and far too heavy for a head. It was never meant to be worn so much as carried, by someone who was not allowed to put it down.

husk-iron_blade.name: Husk-Iron Blade
husk-iron_blade.description: Forged out of whatever the Crypt had to hand, which was largely the previous occupants. It is lighter than it has any business being.

sanctum_shroud.name: Sanctum Shroud
sanctum_shroud.description: Grave-linen that has been somewhere very cold and come back wrong. Things aim slightly to the left of whoever wears it.

wisp_lantern.name: Caught Wisp
wisp_lantern.description: One of the gallery lights, shut in a jar. It has not stopped moving and it has not forgiven you.

marrow_draught.name: Marrow Draught
marrow_draught.description: Thick and faintly warm, and it was not warm when you picked it up.
